parrafo.es: Food truck mexicano en Fort Myers: tacos, quesabirrias, tortas, quesadillas y la birria ramen de la que todos hablan. Cocina a la plancha, al momento, con salsa roja y verde hechas en casa.
parrafo.en: A Mexican food truck in Fort Myers: tacos, quesabirrias, tortas, quesadillas and the birria ramen everyone talks about. Cooked on the griddle, made to order, with house-made red and green salsa.

parrafo_1.es: El Sabor Mexicano es un food truck de cocina auténtica mexicana que opera en Fort Myers desde 2021. Tacos, tortas, quesadillas y quesabirrias, preparados en la plancha al momento de ordenar.
parrafo_1.en: El Sabor Mexicano is an authentic Mexican food truck operating in Fort Myers since 2021. Tacos, tortas, quesadillas and quesabirrias, cooked on the griddle the moment you order.

parrafo_2.es: La especialidad de la casa es la quesabirria con su consomé para mojar, y la birria ramen que varios clientes describen entre lo mejor que han probado en la zona.
parrafo_2.en: The house specialty is the quesabirria with its dipping consommé, and the birria ramen that several customers describe as among the best they have tried in the area.

texto.es: Estamos en 2101 Crystal Dr, Fort Myers. Abrimos todos los días, de 9 AM hasta 9 o 10 PM según el día. Llama antes si quieres confirmar.
texto.en: We are at 2101 Crystal Dr, Fort Myers. Open every day, from 9 AM until 9 or 10 PM depending on the day. Call ahead if you want to confirm.

texto.es: Tacos, tortas, quesadillas, quesabirrias o la birria ramen. Dinos qué se te antoja en la ventanilla.
texto.en: Tacos, tortas, quesadillas, quesabirrias or the birria ramen. Tell us what you are craving at the window.

texto.es: Todo se cocina en la plancha cuando lo pides, con cebolla, cilantro y las salsas de la casa.
texto.en: Everything is cooked on the griddle when you order it, with onion, cilantro and the house salsas.

texto.es: Exprime el limón, moja en el consomé si pediste quesabirria, y listo. Pago solo en efectivo.
texto.en: Squeeze the lime, dip it in the consommé if you ordered quesabirria, and that is it. Cash only.

nota.es: Pregunta por el menú del día en la ventanilla: los precios pueden variar. Pago en efectivo.
nota.en: Ask about the daily menu at the window: prices may vary. Cash only.

texto.es: Con su consomé para mojar. El platillo por el que más nos recomiendan en las reseñas.
texto.en: With dipping consommé on the side. The dish most people recommend us for in the reviews.

tag.es: Para los que quieren algo distinto

texto.es: Fideos ramen en consomé de birria. No es un taco, pero es de lo más pedido por quienes ya nos conocen.
texto.en: Ramen noodles in birria consommé. Not a taco, but one of the most requested items among regulars.

texto.es: Asada, al pastor, pollo y chorizo, en taco o en torta, con cebolla y cilantro.
texto.en: Asada, al pastor, chicken and chorizo, in a taco or a torta, with onion and cilantro.

texto.es: Dobladas en la plancha hasta quedar doraditas, con queso derretido por dentro.
texto.en: Folded on the griddle until golden, with melted cheese inside.

items.quote: The food was delicious, definitely get the birria ramen. It's absolutely worth the $16; they load it up with rich flavor, plenty of noodles, and generous portions of meat. They were also very nice and accommodating.

I come to Florida once per year and always visit El Sabor for a reason. I always eat Quesabirria with the Consommé and I am honest with you, it's under my top 3 things I have ever eaten. Squeeze that lime and dip the Quesabirria into the Consommé and you will feel something you never felt before. Shoutout to the best foodtruck in the states!

I'd like to give a shout out to El Sabor, I showed up 10 minutes before closing and as she was cleaning the grill and I wasn't about to order so she would have to start over but she insisted. I'm glad she did because the pastor torta was not only gigantic but super delicious.
